title: Grateful Dead Live at Dane County Coliseum on 1973-02-15
source: Recording Info: SBD MR > R (Bob Menke) > R (Pat Lee); Transfer Info: Technics 1506 w/Lamb Labs Dolby decoder > WAV (24bit/96k) > Apogee Mini Me 24/96 > Apogee Mini DAC monitoring and mastering > FLAC; Mastered By Matt Smith

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a top‑five‑ranked 1973 show highlighted by a stellar Dark Star > Eyes > China Doll sequence.
ai_review.review: The reviewer raves that this 2/15/73 performance is one of their all‑time favorites, especially urging listeners to hear the Dark Star > Eyes of the World > China Doll stretch. The tape is a soundboard (sbd) recording and, while no specific flaws are noted, its clarity is implied by the enthusiastic recommendation for headphone listening.

ai_rating.rationale: A single, highly positive 5‑star review praises both the musical performance (top‑five show, standout Dark Star sequence) and implies good soundboard quality, leading to a high overall rating despite limited data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No specific technical complaints; reviewer recommends headphone listening, suggesting clear and well‑balanced tape.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewer emphasizes the flow of the Dark Star > Eyes > China Doll segment, indicating a strong second‑set or jam sequence that defines the show’s appeal.
